description: This file defines a React component for a page where users can upload professional documents (resume, job description, performance review), connect LinkedIn, and proceed to generate a career persona. It includes UI components, state management, and interactions with external functions related to persona flow state.

classes.name: SuccessFileCard
classes.description: A React component that displays information about a successfully uploaded file, including a remove button.

classes.name: UploadCard
classes.description: A React component that provides UI for uploading a file of a specific document type, and displays the uploaded file if present.

classes.name: BuildProfileStepPage
classes.description: Main React component representing the upload and connection page for building a career persona.

methods.name: kindLabel
methods.description: Returns a label string for each document kind.

methods.name: kindHelp
methods.description: Returns a help message string describing what to upload for each document kind.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte size into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getDocForKind
methods.description: Retrieves the uploaded document metadata for a specific kind.

methods.name: upsertDoc
methods.description: Adds or updates a document of a specific kind with a new file, updating metadata accordingly.

methods.name: removeKind
methods.description: Removes the uploaded document of the specified kind.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Sets an error message and triggers a visual shake animation.
